question: Has gap G002 already been addressed: Passage-local context-triple supervision has not been evaluated on standard multi-hop KGQA benchmarks, because those benchmarks (WebQSP and CWQ over Freebase, MetaQA over a movies KG, as used in the analyzed retrieval and intermediate-supervision works) are not packaged with source-passage provenance for their triples. Text-attributed resources that would make the mechanism constructible do exist elsewhere - triple-to-source-text traceability in GraphMERT-extracted KGs and large-scale KG-text alignment datasets such as CDTP - but they are used for KG completion and text generation rather than for measuring whether context-triple supervision transfers beyond a single synthetic, domain-specific MCQ setting.?
rationale: A gap is only a hypothesis until a targeted search fails to find work that closes it.
